steps.en: Driver notices due for the first letter are picked for printing
steps.id: Notice driver yang jatuh tempo surat pertama dipilih untuk dicetak
steps.why_en: The nightly schedule does not start letter creation; someone must start it by hand.
steps.why_id: Jadwal malam tidak memulai pembuatan surat; harus dimulai manual.

steps.en: The letter goes to the driver address given by the owner or hirer
steps.id: Surat dikirim ke alamat driver yang diberikan owner atau hirer

steps.en: OCMS builds the data file of the first letter for the printing vendor
steps.id: OCMS membuat file data surat pertama untuk vendor pencetak

steps.en: The file is sent to the printing vendor
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is switched off in the settings, so the file does not leave.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor dimatikan di pengaturan, jadi file tidak keluar.

steps.en: The notice is marked as sent and moves to the next demand stage
steps.id: Notice ditandai terkirim dan pindah ke tahap demand berikutnya
steps.why_en: The stage moves on even when the file never reached the vendor.
steps.why_id: Tahap tetap maju walau file tidak pernah sampai ke vendor.
